newsitem.title: USA: Biocontrol says no material reason for drop.
newsitem.headline: Biocontrol says no material reason for drop.

text.p: Biocontrol Technology Inc said Friday it knows no material reason for the drop in its stock price and blamed rumors spread by short-sellers.
Shares fell from 17/32 to 13/32 on Thursday.

"(The) drop in stock is simply a result of rumors that are out there on the streets promoted by those who are taking a short position in our stock," said Fred Cooper, Biocontrol's chief executive officer. "This has been going on for years, and other shareholders unfortunately seem to follow these kinds of trends and rumors," he said.

The company said the in-home testing in the U.S. Food and Drug Administration protocol for its Diasensor 1000 noninvasive glucose sensor for diabetics is going as planned, and additional financing has been arranged which will enable the company to take its products into the market, especially those involved with the recently formed Chinese joint venture.
